'''D-03A''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] banker posted in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
